_readme: FinQuest daily quiz. A question with "date": "YYYY-MM-DD" (IST) shows on that day. If none matches today, the undated questions rotate by day of year. 'answer' is the 0-based index of the correct option.

questions.q: According to Grant Thornton Bharat’s Q3 2026 Dealtracker report, what was the value of Bank of America Corporation’s acquisition of a 50% stake in Jio Credit?
questions.why: Bank of America’s investment in Jio Credit was announced at up to ₹18,268 crore — about $1.9 billion — covering equity and warrants.

questions.q: Who gets the money in an IPO offer for sale?
questions.why: In an offer for sale, existing shareholders sell their shares, so the proceeds go to them — not to the company. Only a fresh issue raises money for the company.

questions.q: A company reports rising profit but its cash balance is falling. What is the most likely reason?
options: Customers are paying later (receivables are growing)
The company has too little revenue
Profit is always equal to cash
questions.why: Profit is booked when a sale is made; cash arrives when customers pay. Growing receivables or inventory can eat the cash.

questions.q: If a central bank raises its policy rate, what usually happens to the price of existing bonds?
questions.why: Higher rates push market yields up, and bond prices move opposite to yields.

questions.q: Free cash flow is best described as:
options: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditure
questions.why: It is the cash left after the business has paid to maintain and grow its asset base.

questions.q: Which index tracks 50 large companies listed on the NSE?
questions.why: Nifty 50 is the NSE benchmark; the Sensex is the BSE’s 30-stock index.

questions.q: A P/E ratio compares a company’s share price to its:
questions.why: P/E = price ÷ earnings per share: how much investors pay for each rupee or dollar of earnings.

questions.q: Which of these is a regulator of India’s securities markets?
questions.why: SEBI regulates securities markets. IRDAI oversees insurance and PFRDA oversees pensions.
